Visa Types & Pathways

Navigating the visa process is easier with EduLink. We assist with all major Australian visa types and help you choose the right pathway for your goals.

Student Visa (Subclass 500)

For full-time study at universities, TAFEs, or colleges

Temporary Graduate Visa (Subclass 485)

For graduates seeking post-study work experience

Working Holiday Visa (Subclass 417/462)

For short-term work and travel opportunities

Skilled Migration Visas

For qualified professionals aiming for permanent residency

Visitor & Family Visas

For family visits or dependent sponsorship

Training & Internship Visa (Subclass 407)

For skill-based training and placements

Our 6-Step Process

01

Free Consultation

Book a free assessment to discuss your goals, qualifications, and explore your options with our expert consultants.

02

Pathway Planning

We create a personalized study and career pathway tailored to your goals, budget, and timeline.

03

Application Support

Our team assists with university applications, document preparation, and ensures everything meets requirements.

04

Visa Guidance

We guide you through the entire visa application process, from documentation to submission and follow-up.

05

Pre-Departure

Comprehensive pre-departure support including accommodation, orientation, and practical advice for your move.

06

Ongoing Support

Continued support throughout your studies including visa renewals, course changes, and career guidance.
